Gives the address of each link as the page wrote it, beside the resolved address

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Crawlberg\Crawlberg;
$engine = Crawlberg::createEngine(null);
$url = "https://example.com";
$result = Crawlberg::scrape($engine, $url);
var_dump(count($result->getLinks()));
var_dump($result->getLinks()[0]->originalUrl);
var_dump($result->getLinks()[0]->url);
```
